The numbers for "The Price is Right™" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2774.headline: A close look at the prizes

2775.body:
On "Casino 7s", one $100,000 top prize was claimed earlier this week. That leaves three of the original four. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

If "Casino 7s" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2775.headline: Fewer $100,000 prizes left

2776.body:
About a quarter of the tickets for "Patriotic Payout" have been sold. The game is still new. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

Tomorrow's count on "Patriotic Payout" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2776.headline: How far along this game is

2779.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Gnome for the Holidays", about three-quarters are still unsold. The game is still new, with 42 of 57 top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

The numbers for "Gnome for the Holidays" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2779.headline: Where this game is in its run

2780.body:
"Holiday Countdown" has 602,274 prizes of $5 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $1,000 prize, with 47 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

Today's free summary of "Holiday Countdown" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
2780.headline: What's actually left to win

2781.body:
"The Perfect Gift" has five of five top prizes left and is near the start of its run. About a quarter of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

Every line of The Perfect Gift's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2781.headline: Tickets sold so far

2782.body:
"$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game built around small prizes that are won often. Of its unclaimed prize money, nearly all is in wins under $10,000 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

For "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" or any game, being late in a run is not automatically good or bad. The same numbers mean different things near the end of a run.

Tomorrow's count on "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2782.headline: How this game pays out

2783.body:
"30X The Cash" just reached Texas stores with five top prizes of $30,000. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the overall odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

The numbers for "30X The Cash" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2783.headline: Brand new, no claims yet

2784.body:
"Lucky Scratch" has joined the Texas lineup at $5 with four top prizes of $100,000. Only on the first day do the overall odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

Everything above about "Lucky Scratch" comes from the Texas Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2784.headline: A brand-new game to watch
